Best breakfast in Vietnam
Oct 2026 • Couples
We had breakfast at Mad Cow every morning during our stay, and it was genuinely one of the best breakfasts we have had anywhere in Vietnam\.

A very special thank you to Giau, who was absolutely fantastic\. She knew our order before we had even sat down, was incredibly attentive and intuitive, and always greeted us so warmly\. She made every morning feel personal and welcoming\.

We also want to recognise Hang, who was often in the red polo shirt\. She was equally attentive, kind and always smiling\. Between Giau, Hang and the rest of the team, the service was consistently excellent\. Everyone was friendly, professional and genuinely seemed to care that we were enjoying ourselves\.

And then there was the breakfast itself — absolutely stunning\. Where else do you get flame\-grilled steak for breakfast? The quality and variety were exceptional, and even the small details stood out, like beautiful French butter with fresh baguettes\.

The entire Mad Cow team helped make breakfast one of the highlights of our stay\. Thank you for looking after us so well each morning\.

Poor service
Oct 2025 • Family
We had booked this restaurant a month in advance for our final night at the resort. A special evening to celebrate our twins’ birthday as a family. Sadly, what was meant to be a joyful memory turned into a disappointing experience.

For a family-friendly resort, it was surprising that there was no kids’ menu available. Service felt rushed and our main dishes arrived before we finished our starters, and bread and butter were only served after we asked, as our children were already hungry. My wife’s main came out late, and my own dish was mistakenly served twice.

The most disheartening part was when the cake arrived with “Happy Anniversary” written on it instead of “Happy Birthday,” even though this was clearly confirmed in advance. It felt as if no one truly cared about making this family moment special.

We left feeling sad and let down, especially after looking forward to this evening for so long. For the price and reputation, we expected much more care, value and attention. It’s a shame to end a wonderful holiday on such a note.

Will definitely not come back.
